page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 128 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. System memory totals 256.0 GB, allocating exactly 2.0 GB of memory per vCPU core.

The instance provides high-bandwidth network performance with a 64 Gbps baseline rating. It does not include local storage disks or integrated GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage solutions for persistent data needs. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM balance provides distinct cost efficiency for processing-heavy workloads that do not require high memory density, though the lack of local ephemeral disks requires accounting for external storage latency.

The resource profile of the ecs.c7.32xlarge makes it well suited for parallel compute tasks. Primary workload fits include continuous integration pipelines, batch data processing, high-density web serving, and distributed application processing.
